description: Angular component for GPIO panel widget settings, managing form controls for GPIO items, including adding, removing, and validation.

classes.name: GpioPanelWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring GPIO panel widget settings, including form management and GPIO item list manipulation.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for GPIO panel widget settings.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default widget settings, including background color and empty GPIO list.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided widget settings.

methods.name: doUpdateSettings
methods.description: Updates the form with new settings, particularly the GPIO list.

methods.name: prepareGpioListFormArray
methods.description: Creates a form array for GPIO items with validation and list validation.

methods.name: gpioListFormArray
methods.description: Retrieves the GPIO list form array.

methods.name: trackByGpioItem
methods.description: Provides tracking for GPIO items in the form array.

methods.name: removeGpioItem
methods.description: Removes a GPIO item at specified index.

methods.name: addGpioItem
methods.description: Adds a new GPIO item with default null properties to the form.
